_readme: Golden cases: in-game measured numbers that pin the engine to reality.
Fill `expected` from actual game measurements (pip-boy damage card or hit
numbers vs a known target). Cases with `expected: null` are skipped.
scenario: freeAim | vats. Sneak and weakpoint targeting are player
conditions/enemyConditions patch the defaults from src/types/index.ts.
